jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Golang Engineer (EMEA)
jobs.description: WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity. Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures. The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In . We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat. About the Role We're building WunderGraph Cosmo, the open-source GraphQL Federation solution. Probably the most important component of Cosmo is the Cosmo Router, which - simply put - connects all API endpoints and handles the GraphQL requests and responses whilst applying the Federation protocol (among other magical things, like normalization, execution planning etc.). Fully written in Go, it's the fastest GraphQL Router available and a quite potent (and complex) piece of cutting-edge open-source software. How about joining our team to make it even better and strap the rocket boosters onto GraphQL Federation? TEAM INTEGRATION You align with the Product team and Customer Success teams for product feedback You support and consult with the engineering team. You will be in charge of Develop, refactor and maintain GraphQL Go Tools' (Router) open-source code base in Golang (low GC code) Work closely with your engineering team mates on new Router capabilities (e.g. Open Federation, new data sources) Focus on performance, security and stability of the Router Review Router telemetry to identify areas of improvement Run internal penetration tests of the Router Troubleshoot Router issues, potentially together with our customers' engineers Analyze and accept up open-source contributions on Github The "Engine" is essentially a Golang application which translates GraphQL requests into any other protocol, like OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, etc. You could consider the Engine as a "GraphQL Compiler" or Transpiler. The Engine is responsible for parsing, normalization, execution planning, execution runtime, etc... If you are interested in working with ASTs, AST transformations, etc... you will love this kind of work. We have performance requirements, so you should be proficient in writing performant and low GC code in Golang. Some of your tasks will take more than a few weeks to complete, Ideally, you're someone who likes to go deep on one topic instead of going wide and shallow on many different topics. jobs.description: Your mission Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis). Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations). Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs). Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization. Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs. Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run. Your profile Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority. Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus! Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you. Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations. Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup. Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary. Why us? Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy. Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale. Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company. Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. You'll take technical ownership of the data platform behind how we run the business: the pipelines, the warehouse, and the definitions behind the numbers our leadership team actually uses. You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work alongside a colleague who owns the business-facing side of data, plus our infrastructure and application engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role with no line management in either direction, roughly 70% hands-on building, 30% defining, documenting and explaining. Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role JUPUS supports hundreds of law firms across Europe, and our customer base is growing roughly 4x a year. Our data platform has grown with it (ClickHouse, dbt, Python extract-load pipelines into an S3 data lake, orchestration in GitHub Actions) and it has grown fast. Your job is to make it trustworthy. That means modernising what already exists, making historical trends a record of what actually happened rather than a nightly re-derivation of it, and owning the definitions behind the metrics that reach our board. This is not a greenfield build, and it is not a maintenance seat. It is a real platform with real problems, and you would own it. Tasks Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and the raw layer, the ClickHouse warehouse, and the dbt project on top of it. You're the person who can say whether a number is wrong or the pipeline is. Make our numbers trustworthy: reliability, correctness, and a history that holds up, so that a trend is a record of what actually happened rather than a re-derivation of it. Own the metrics the company runs on , starting with our customer health score- the definition, the denominator, the eligibility rules and the known limitations, not just the SQL underneath them. Turn business questions into durable metrics: work directly with Customer Success, Sales, Product and leadership to understand what they're actually trying to decide, then build something defensible enough to decide on. Keep cost and complexity in check as we grow: warehouse architecture, query cost, and the surfaces that deliver data into BI and our CRM. All of it gets harder as the customer base multiplies. Set the standard for how data work is done here: one authoritative written definition per leadership-visible number, and the conventions that inform our Data function as it grows with us. Requirements Technical Expertise Substantial experience in data engineering or analytics engineering , with production ownership of a warehouse and a transformation layer. We care more about evidence of ownership than about years served. ClickHouse in production. dbt at ownership level: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, CI/CD. Ideally you've inherited someone else's dbt project and left it better than you found it. Python data engineering: EL tooling, S3, CI-based orchestration that you’ve owned end to end, with no platform team behind you. Product event streams: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or similar. You understand how user-to-company identity and group association break, and what that does to every metric downstream. Judgement and Ownership You have defined a business KPI end to end and defended it to non-technical people. This is the differentiator for us. An excellent engineer who takes requirements as given is not the right fit for this role. Analytical rigour: cohorts, correct denominators, sample size stated before findings. You'll say "we can't tell yet, and here's exactly why" rather than produce a confident chart. You act without waiting for a ticket , and you can name something you chose to stop doing. You're comfortable in front of senior stakeholders , including C-level, and can hold a technical line without losing the room. Further Requirements Located within CET +/-2 . Nice to have: BI tool administration (we use Metabase), CRM and billing systems

jobs.title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie. BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer. SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dein Talent SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE&nbsp;</u></span></strong></p> <p>The <strong>Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys</strong> owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. Looking to the future, we aim to further reduce the barriers between design to code and code to design allowing ideation, prototyping and productionalising to happen seamlessly where it most makes sense.</p> <p>Our Roundtripping team is expanding, and we’re hiring AI Product Engineers across multiple levels in the UK. jobs.description: About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query . Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval. In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit. Drive Query intelligence: Lead the Query team to push boundaries in tokenization, spell correction, entity extraction, intent classification, and LLM-assisted query parsing across multiple languages. Advance Recall systems: Lead the Machine Learning & Recall team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models. Move core business metrics: Own measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals. Turn research into production wins: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low-latency, cost-effective production systems. Balance ML performance trade-offs: Make data-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real-time execution constraints. Build evaluation frameworks: Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes. Orchestrate pipeline handoffs: Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss. Solve systemic issues: Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one-off patches. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have: Evolved our hybrid recall framework to measurably improve candidate generation precision for long-tail queries and complex catalog structures. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one. What you will do Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France. Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner. Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem. What You Bring Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies. A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups. Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations. jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. France-based opportunity. Work from anywhere in France (travel to customer sites as needed). We have bases in Berlin and are expanding into France. Flexible working hours because you know best when you work most efficiently. Open culture with regular team collaboration and learning opportunities. You'll work on the founding team for a high-growth function - significant opportunity for impact and rapid growth. Your work will make a real impact, helping alleviate workload for healthcare professionals and improving care documentation quality. Competitive salary and benefits package. 25 days of paid vacation per year + French public holidays. ✨ Ready to talk? We look forward to your application. jobs.title: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. About the Role This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses. You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound. Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies. What You'll Do Own the numbers • Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation. • Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements. • Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance. • Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report. • Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations. • Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO. Drive the growth agenda • Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them. • Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business. • Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent. • Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control. • Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI. • Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region. Who We're Looking For • An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business. • Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output. • Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it. • A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent). • 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finan

Ce recrutement intervient dans le cadre du projet de maturation CHRONOS soutenu par la SATT LUCTECH. Votre mission Contribuer activement à la conception logicielle d'un prototype innovant de mesure et de traitement de signaux HD-sEMG (électromyographie de surface haute densité). En tant qu’acteur/actrice clé du projet, vous serez engagé(e) dans un processus complet de création de « briques » technologiques : spécifications, programmation, caractérisation et qualifications expérimentales jusqu’aux tests de fiabilité en environnement réel. jobs.title: Ingénieur de recherche F/H Détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes par apprentissage très faiblement supervisé : Etudes, applications et transposition des méthodes Visual Large Model à l’industrie du futur.
jobs.description: Ce recrutement s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PostGenAI piloté par Sorbonne Université. Le projet est soutenu par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche ( ANR ), dans le cadre du plan d'investissement gouvernemental  France 2030 . Vos missions Assurer une étude scientifique rigoureuse, visant à comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes. Prendre en charge l’étude complète, dimensionner les critères d’évaluations ainsi que les configurations de déploiement des modèles, mener les expérimentations associées. Contribuer à l’écriture d’articles scientifiques reprenant les résultats de l’étude et proposant des recommandations quant à la transposition et au déploiement des modèles VLM dans l’industrie. Activités principales Le sujet traite de la problématique générale de la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes dans l’industrie. L’industrie doit se doter d’outils d’inspection de confiance rapidement déployables en production. Les solutions d’IA supervisées les plus performantes reposent sur une activité préalable longue et coûteuses d’étiquetage d’images par des experts-process (plusieurs centaines d’étiquetages d’images). Les anomalies visuelles complexes sont : (1) des défauts logiques où les modèles doivent détecter et contrôler la logique de positionnement relatif entre différents objets ou entités de la scène. Il s’agit par exemple : du contrôle de l’absence/présence de pièces ou composants, de la détection d’erreurs de câblages etc. (2), ils sont aussi des défauts de texture, comme des opacités, des fissures, des arrachements, etc. L’activité principale du poste sera d’étudier puis de comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection de ces anomalies. Les critères de couts seront pris en comptes (liés à l’inférence, à l’étiquetage, aux formulations des prompts et à la consommation électrique, etc). Les différents types de modèles (format ouvert, propriétaire etc.) seront à considérer pour l’étude.  Sur la base des résultats obtenus, des recommandations quant à la transposition de ces méthodes à l’industrie seront proposées puis valorisées auprès d’industriels partenaires de l’UTC. La rédaction, la soumission et la publication dans des journaux scientifiques sont attendues. Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 21/09/2026 au 20/10/2026 Type de contrat et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Contrat à durée déterminée - durée prévue de 18 mois - à pourvoir en octobre 2026 Salaire mensuel brut Selon expérience et financement Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes par semaine - 1 607 heures par an Contexte scientifique / résumé du projet Le cluster PostGenAI@Paris a pour ambition d’anticiper les ruptures de l’intelligence artificielle et d’en maîtriser les enjeux scientifiques, sociétaux et éthiques — là où les frontières entre technologie et intelligence humaine deviennent progressivement indistinctes. https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.fr Le projet porte sur le CAP 1.6 AI for Industry, qui a pour objectif de développer des méthodes d’explicabilité et de quantification d’incertitude pour rendre l’IA utilisable, auditable et vraiment opérationnelle dans les décisions industrielles liées aux risques. https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.fr/pac/cap-1.6 Bien qu’il existe un nombre de solutions important (méthodes locales, méthodes globales (Carvalho et al., 2024)), une marge de progression est encore nécessaire sur les taux de fausses alarmes. Les premières constatations issues de l’étude benchmark sur AutoVI montrent que pour des défauts logiques (des câblages par exemple) le taux de fausses alarmes est compris entre 5% et 20%. Il est donc primordial d’apporter de nouvelles méthodes aidant à expliquer les raisons d’une fausse activation. Par conséquent, un verrou attaqué dans ce projet concerne la réduction des taux de fausses alarmes et l'amélioration de l'explicabilité des résultats pour les images incorrectement classées comme défectueuses

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei: Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Corporate (Mid-Market)-Segment. Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline. Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern. Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu präsentieren. Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts. Was dich auszeichnet: 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden. Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss. Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross- funktionalen Teams. Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten. jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once – from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools that sit at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll work on making sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets to hit our goals, help allocate those levers across markets, and dig into problem areas to find and fix root causes. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations – one for someone who's as comfortable building a model as they are diving into why a specific market is off plan. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations & courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. What you'll be doing Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc. Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets. Allocate levers across markets: Own within-market supply lever allocation – translating high-level market planning into concrete, market-specific plans. Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. Our humble expectations 3+ years experience in operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems. Proficiency in Looker, SQL, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling is a must; other relevant analytical tools are a plus, including Python, Cursor, and Claude Code. An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious – always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change. The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders  – both local and global. A true culture champion – someone who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. You are located in either Berlin or Helsinki with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.  Next steps What to expect from our hiring process: Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation

Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.</p> <p>As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.</p> <p>The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. We're looking for engineers who care as much about the experience of the people who use their systems as they do about the quality of the systems themselves, who take responsibility from architecture to production, and who find meaning in work whose impact compounds quietly across an entire organization. jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong. If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will: Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others). Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling. Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging. Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities. Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers. Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations. What you bring You'll thrive in this role if you have: Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar). Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling. Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems. Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana). Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus. Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines. jobs.description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system. The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day. Build your own pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, industry events, field visits, and existing networks. Manage diverse sales cycles, from agile, family-run food suppliers to complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. What you bring 3+ years of experience in software sales, ideally progressing from SDR/BDR into an Account Executive role, with hands-on experience owning and closing deals. A track record of consistently overachieving against sales quotas and targets. Consistent achievement of self-sourced pipeline generation and outbound activity targets. Experience managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close. A strong track record of outbound prospecting and creating your own pipeline. Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment, managing multiple opportunities and maintaining momentum across your pipeline. Fluency in French and English (C1+) Proven ability to manage mid-market sales cycles with a focus on value-based selling and long-term partnership growth. Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working with internal teams to deliver complex solutions to sophisticated business customers. What you get Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets. Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins. Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end. jobs.description: We are hiring an Investor Relations Associate to help grow the investor side of Pairs, the network of family offices and high-net-worth individuals our founders raise from. Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast. The role The craft of this seat is allocator trust, and we are hiring people early in that craft who are already showing they have it. You will work alongside our senior investor team on live mandates: qualifying allocators, preparing briefs, running follow-ups, and keeping investor relationships warm between deals. And from day one you will build your own: identifying family offices and HNWIs who back US startups, earning first conversations, and growing a book that is yours. You do not need a decade of relationships. You need the beginnings of a real network, a method for growing it that you can explain, and the discipline to treat other people's capital and privacy with care. The rest, the mandate craft, the briefing standard, the judgment calls, you learn here, working next to people who do this every day. One thing this seat is not: technical. Our engineers build the platform and the agents. You work inside them, so your hours go to investors instead of admin. What you will own Your growing book. The allocator relationships you bring and the ones you open here, qualified and kept warm. Mandate support that matters. Investor qualification, briefing notes, and follow-through on live deals, done to the house standard. New doors. jobs.description: <p>P-1584</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.</p> <p>Lakebase enables teams to deliver applications faster with an optimised database developer experience, integration with the lakehouse, and simplified operations. It provides a managed Postgres transactional layer for application state and workloads that combine operational data, analytics, and AI. You'll join as one of the founding leaders building out both the Lakebase product and our London presence.</p> <p>This is a Tech Lead Manager role: a hands-on technical leader who guides a small team of around five engineers while staying deep in the engineering work. You'll spend the majority of your time hands-on — driving architecture and design, solving the hardest problems in your team's projects, aligning with partner teams on dependencies, and writing code — and the rest leading and growing the engineers around you, who will report directly to you. It's&nbsp; role for a strong senior engineer who wants to lead a team and take on people management without stepping away from the technical work.</p> <p>The team you will lead (one of):</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lakebase Platform Reliability (LPR)</strong> — Constantly evolve Lakebase reliability: cross-functional infrastructure, observability, SLI/SLO definition and measurement, and higher operational efficiency without humans-in-the-loop, for both internal and customer-facing systems, by building AI-powered automation and services.</li> <li><strong>Lakebase Proxy</strong> — Build the heart of the Lakebase data path, the network edge that every customer touches. The proxy handles all client connections and transfers every byte of query traffic, serving every data protocol: Postgres, HTTP, WebSockets, and the Data API. We route and manage large volumes of concurrent connections, solving load balancing, authentication, and data access at high throughput, with a focus on performance, observability, and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Lakebase Storage</strong> — Drive continuous delivery within a team of experts in storage technology, distributed systems, and Rust. Lancée il y a seulement trois ans, OESF est aujourd'hui en pleine phase de scale-up : plus de 50 collaborateurs, une équipe commerciale d'une vingtaine de personnes, et une activité en forte croissance avec l'ambition d'accélérer fortement notre développement dans les prochaines années. L'organisation est en place, mais beaucoup reste encore à construire et à optimiser : process, outils, automatisation, IA, méthodes de vente... Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui souhaite  prendre une part active à cette phase de scale-up, piloter notre performance commerciale et construire l'organisation de demain.   Notre organisation commerciale :  Notre modèle repose sur un binôme Business Developer / Technico-Commercial : 15 Business Developers (commerciaux sédentaires) , répartis entre nos bureaux de Paris et Lille et encadrés par 2 Team Leaders. Organisés en équipes de télévente, ils prennent en charge les leads, qualifient les projets, réalisent les études solaires et pilotent la vente à distance jusqu'à la signature . 3 Technico-Commerciaux terrain , encadrés par 1 Team Leader, réalisent les visites techniques chez les particuliers avec un double rôle : valider la faisabilité technique du projet et contribuer activement à la vente . Le/la Sales Manager manage directement ces 3 Team Leaders , ainsi qu'une équipe marketing. Le poste est basé à Paris et implique des déplacements réguliers à Lille pour rester proche des équipes et du terrain. Ta mission :  En tant que Sales Manager, tu es responsable de la performance commerciale de l'activité Services, de la prise en charge du lead jusqu'à la vente , sur nos différentes offres : installations photovoltaïques avec ou sans batterie, batteries seules et bornes de recharge. Ton rôle est à la fois managérial, opérationnel et entrepreneurial : faire progresser les équipes, améliorer continuellement notre modèle de vente et construire les process et outils nécessaires à notre croissance.   Manager et développer les équipes : Manager et accompagner tes N-1 dans le pilotage quotidien de leurs équipes. Être un manager proche du terrain : écouter les appels, analyser les rendez-vous, comprendre les objections clients. Développer une culture forte du coaching commercial et de l'amélioration continue, et faire progresser les équipes sur les techniques de télévente, la connaissance produit et les outils. Anticiper les besoins de recrutement, participer activement aux recrutements et garantir la qualité de l'onboarding. Suivre la performance individuelle, accompagner les collaborateurs en difficulté avec des objectifs clairs, et prendre les décisions managériales qui s'imposent. Favoriser l'engagement et la rétention des meilleurs talents. Piloter et être responsable de la performance commerciale : Être responsable des unit economics de l'organisation commerciale : volume de ventes, panier moyen, coût d'acquisition par installation. Piloter le funnel commercial et les taux de conversion à chaque étape ; construire un forecast fiable. Agir sur les leviers du coût d'acquisition : conversion, productivité des équipes, organisation du parcours de vente, dimensionnement de l'équipe. Analyser les performances et mettre rapidement en place les plans d'action nécessaires. Construire le modèle commercial : Notre modèle de vente n'est pas figé — c'est en partie pour ça que ce poste est stratégique. On attend de cette personne qu'elle soit co-auteure du modèle, pas seulement son exécutante. Créer, tester et déployer de nouveaux process commerciaux avec une approche test & learn : expérimenter, mesurer, industrialiser ce qui foncti

jobs.title: Customer Success Public Sector
jobs.description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy   Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:   - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently   Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐   At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. You will join Malt as a Customer Onboarding & Success Manager - Public Sector , based in Paris Manager Customer Success - Global, Public sector & SMB, you will work hand-in-hand and transversally with our Account Managers dedicated to the Public Sector.  Your main mission will be to ensure the smooth deployment and flawless execution of framework agreements ( accords-cadres ) and public tenders throughout their lifecycle. You will be the guarantor of compliance with public procedures and tracking commitments, acting as the primary operational point of contact for public beneficiaries and freelancers. Key responsibilities ✨ Onboarding & Pedagogy: Pitch platform benefits, lead training sessions, and perform product demos to drive user independence within ministries, local authorities, and public institutions. Public Tender Execution & Tracking: Anticipate the end of purchase orders or contracts, and provide proactive follow-ups to ensure business continuity and secure renewals (contract renewals, new market lots). Public Administrative & Budgetary Management: Pilot operational processes specific to the public sector (management and compliance of quotes/purchase orders, tracking Legal Commitments ( Engagements Juridiques ), validating activity reports/CRA for non-autonomous clients), and monitor budget consumption. Beneficiary Relations & Satisfaction: Act as the dedicated go-to person to centralize requests from public decision-makers and resolve operational incidents. Contractual Expertise (SLAs & CCAG): Master the specificities of technical/administrative specifications (CCTP, CCAP, CCAG) and service level agreements (SLAs) unique to each framework agreement to align our internal ways of working. Continuous Improvement: Identify operational pain points unique to public administrative processes and collaborate with Ops, Product, and Tech teams to automate and adapt our platform to public sector constraints. About you 🧑‍🚀 Experience: A previous public sector experience is mandatory for this job ! Solid background in managing complex client relationships, onboarding large accounts, or operational contract management Administrative Rigor: A keen sense of organization and familiarity with the inner workings of public administration (notions of public procurement, purchase orders, Chorus Pro, and budgetary validation workflows). Solution-Oriented: Excellent interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to resolve disputes or complex situations with a variety of stakeholders (from Procurement Directors to technical Project Managers). Tools & Data: Advanced proficiency in collaborative and analytical tools (Gsheet/Excel, Notion, Looker) and an appetite for AI applications. Languages: Native/fluent level of French (essential for dealing with the French administration) and professional level of English (as internal processes and the Malt team are international). How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with our Talent Acquisition team to better understand your background and aspirations (30-45 minutes). Interview with your future manager to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI, Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz) €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution) In-house German classes Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications) International team, English-speaking environment Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Senior Product Designer Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it. You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most. What you'll do Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish. Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact. Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities. Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on. Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass. Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea. Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes. What you'll bring 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work. Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools. Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight. Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases. Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams. Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces. Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation. Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain. We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.   L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 🎯  Ce que nous attendons de vous : En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre de Formation et de Recherche CMP qui est situé à Gardanne (dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, 13). Il est l’un des cinq centres de formation et de recherche de l’Ecole. Il comprend quatre départements de recherche dont le département d’Electronique Flexible (FEL) au sein duquel le poste de postdoctorant est ouvert. Le département FEL compte 25 personnes, dont 7 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 ingénieur et 15 chercheurs postdoctoraux et doctorants. La mission porte sur le développement d’une batterie biodégradable au sodium pour dispositifs médicaux temporaires. Le système sera entièrement composé de matériaux biorésorbables, avec une durée de vie ajustable. jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission
