jobs.title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit. The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture. The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale. In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit. About this role: Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability. Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase. Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code. Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches. Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards. Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases. In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites. Must Haves: 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python. Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar). Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake). Understanding of distributed architecture. Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP , TCP, IP) and POSIX standards. Experience in developing multi-threaded applications. Previous team leader or manager role Nice to Haves: Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust. Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms. Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity) Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ / NATS , etc.) Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S , systemd-nspawn) Experience with space systems and concepts Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! jobs.title: Technicien Systèmes et Réseaux - Alternance
jobs.description: 📍 Localisation : Nantes (Île de Nantes) 🕒 Date de prise de poste : janvier 2027 🌍 Langues : français courant (> C1) et anglais professionnel (> B2) 🏡 2 jours de télétravail par semaine 🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable. Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution. Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays . Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel , au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone . À propos de l’équipe IT interne L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone . Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager , responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux. Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes . L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS ( Windows, macOS et Linux ) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement. Objectif du poste Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne , aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités , aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration.  Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance . ⌨️ Tes principales missions Support utilisateurs Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire Parc informatique Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements Systèmes, accès & réseaux Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT Sécurité & amélioration continue Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement Requirements 🏹 Profil recherché Connaissances : Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN) Connaissances initiales en admin

jobs.title: Commercial Terrain - Indépendant (Freelance)
jobs.description: Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues. Vos missions Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ; Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ; Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille. La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni. Votre rémunération Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond : 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ; 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois. Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois. Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti. Vos outils et votre organisation SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner. Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni. Votre profil Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ; À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ; Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ; Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ; Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage. Processus de recrutement Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ; Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ; Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation. Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !   Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

It is command and control software that has to present dense real-time information, coordinate distributed systems, and continue being useful when communications are imperfect. jobs.title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
jobs.description: About Genesis AI Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world. About the Role A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem. We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out. The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't. Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on. You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging. What You'll Do Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use What We're Looking For (ideally) 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job system

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX. Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime. What you’ll own API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches. IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality. Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform. Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking. Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works. The project as a product. Benchmark

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Unsere Opportunity Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche. Deine Mission Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver. Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und den anderen Engineers zusammen, damit wir das bauen, was zählt - nicht nur das, was dir gesagt wurde. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist. Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern. Tech-Stack: TypeScript (NestJS im Backend, React im Frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (mehrere Datenbanken inkl. PostGIS), Queue-basierte Job-Verarbeitung, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), Infrastructure-as-Code, Claude Was du konkret tust Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver. Du modellierst komplexe Immobilien- und ESG-Domänen in relationalen Schemas. Wir betreiben mehrere Postgres-Datenbanken parallel (eine davon geospatial), und Schema-Entscheidungen haben hier langfristige Konsequenzen. Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt. Du entwickelst unser Berechtigungsmodell weiter. Unsere Kunden reichen vom einzelnen Eigentümer bis zum Konzern mit Zugriff auf Organisations-, Portfolio- und Gebäudeebene. Das richtig zu bauen ist echte Design-Arbeit, keine Middleware-Konfiguration. Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar. Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur. Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt. Woran wir Erfolg messen Du hast Features end-to-end über Schema, API und Hintergrundverarbeitung ausgeliefert, die unsere Kunden aktiv nutzen. Unsere asynchrone Verarbeitung (Importe, Extraktion, Analyse-Jobs) ist messbar robuster: weniger stille Fehler, klare Retry- und Recovery-Pfade und Observability, die uns sagt, was kaputt ist und warum. Reproduce and structure them into actionable input for Product Engineering and R&D. Requirements 3+ years of full-time experience in a technically demanding engineering role, with evidence that you have independently owned complex projects from an ambiguous starting point through a real-world outcome. jobs.description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona , and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role You'll join a two-person ML team and a forecasting system making half hourly demand predictions across diverse targets for multiple restaurant chains. Our forecasting models enter into a complex environment with key machine and human decisions being made on their predictions, facing feedback loops and a highly variable environment. The system works - the challenge now is scaling it from a handful of clients to 100s. You'll own client launches end-to-end: validating data, selecting models, running UAT, going live, and monitoring performance afterwards. You'll join client calls, build relationships, and understand what actually matters on the ground - not just whether the model is accurate, but whether the kitchen prepped the right amount of food. You'll love this role if: You enjoy taking ownership of the product and outcome end-to-end. Machine learning at Sona is a success if we have happy clients running successful businesses as well as the models which are best in industry You have a focus on solving the problem and when given the choice between "complicated and shiny" vs "get something simple in front of a user", you choose the latter You're excited by working with our industry experts to really understand what's happening in our client's businesses and the realities of working there You see beyond the data to the world that resulted in this data generating process, the issues that come with it and the opportunity that it gives us You're experienced in and excited by taking a machine learning project from business idea to deployed production system You default to AI tools for development and you're excited by what they can achieve for ML. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.title: Virtual Bookkeeper
jobs.description: About Strong Roots Accounting Strong Roots Accounting is a small accounting firm based in Fort Worth, Texas, serving small businesses and nonprofits with accurate, reliable bookkeeping and financial insight. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month. We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. Our vision is bigger than bookkeeping: we are building something that creates meaningful opportunities for people to build long-lasting stability and confidence in their future. We are growing — intentionally and carefully — and we are looking for the right person to grow with us. This Is Who We Are We operate by a set of values and principles that are non-negotiable. They are not posted on a wall and forgotten. They are how we show up every day. Core Values: Trust Quality Contribution Our Principles: Honesty and accuracy above all. Be curious. Ask why. And solve problems. Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication. Repeatable processes are the only option. If you read those and felt something — keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay. This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following: People who cut corners and hope no one notices People who go quiet when things get hard People who need to be micromanaged to deliver People who treat accuracy as optional People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well — just not here. The Role The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job. Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day — there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder — we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track. Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together. This is a remote, backend bookkeeping position supporting our Client Relationship Manager. You will not have direct contact with clients — your job is to execute the bookkeeping work accurately, quietly, and on time so our team can deliver a seamless experience on the client-facing side. You will manage end-of-month reconciliations across approximately 30 small business and nonprofit client accounts. Work is assigned by our Client Relationship Manager, who will be your primary point of contact for priorities, questions, and feedback. This role may be part-time or full-time — we are open to the right fit and will discuss arrangements with the right candidate. What You Will Do Perform end-of-month bank reconciliations across a portfolio of small business and nonprofit clients Categorize and organize transactions accurately within QuickBooks Online Ensure client books are clean, consistent, and completed on time every month Flag discrepancies or unusual items to the Client Relationship Manager for review Fo

Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy. Who You Are: Product-minded, business-first Obsessed with simplicity First principles thinker Fast. Bias toward action Experience: You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company. You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling. You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team. Why Lemon.io : Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals. A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open. Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship. A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers. A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.description: Welcome to Ovation Healthcare! At Ovation Healthcare, we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions. The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare's vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior. We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork. Ovation Healthcare's corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit Summary As a Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models, and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services. You will work extensively within Fabric's Lakehouse and Warehouse environments — building well-structured data models and developing Fabric Notebooks (PySpark/Spark SQL) for data transformation at scale — and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and efficient data solutions that drive business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives. Duties and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services. Design and implement data models within Microsoft Fabric — including Lakehouse and Warehouse architectures, medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering, and star-schema semantic models optimized for Direct Lake reporting. Build, maintain, and optimize Fabric Notebooks (PySpark, Spark SQL, and/or Python) to ingest, cleanse, and transform data at scale, applying performance best practices for Spark compute and Delta Lake tables. Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver actionable insights. Implement data ingestion, transformation, and integration workflows (pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks) following best practices for security and performance. Evaluate and choose the right Fabric tool for the job — pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, or notebooks — based on complexity, performance, and maintainability tradeoffs. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines, notebooks, and data models to ensure high availability and accuracy. Ensure data solutions comply with organizational data governance policies and industry regulations. Document data models, architectures, processes, and workflows for operational transparency and knowledge sharing. jobs.title: Rockborne Data Training Programme
jobs.description: Are you a graduate keen on data and looking for a chance to kickstart your career? Rockborne could be the place for you with our Data Programme! Our mission is to grow, develop and deploy the world’s leading data professionals, make real change in the data industry through the diversity of thought and keep quality at the heart of everything we do. The Programme Our Academy is a 12-week free online training programme that is designed and delivered by our dedicated in-house team of data gurus and industry legends. We focus on all elements of Data from Data Analytics to Data Science and more, whilst also putting huge emphasis on communication and professional skills. The curriculum is like no other, it is packed full of everything we know the data industry and our clients need. You’ll be taken through a carefully curated training programme that covers Excel, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, Python, Data Governance, GenAI, Presentation skills, Stakeholder Management and more. On completing the Academy you’ll commence to the next stage in your learning and development and join us on Advance! Advance is where you’ll take your data and AI skills to the next level through various projects and sprints. This additional 12 weeks of development is the real game changer, being designed to enhance and hone your newly found data and AI skills. This will take you from data novice to a data ninja – having every tool at your disposal to tackle data and AI challenges and bring real value. During the Advance period we will organise interviews with our clients across the data industry and aim for you to join us as a Rockborne employee and become a Data Consultant with one of our clients for the next two years, this would be your Assignment! Assignments are across the UK but are mainly focused in London and are with a broad and diverse client group, from financial services to aviation to pharmaceutical. When you commence an assignment you’ll become a Rockborne employee and receive a salary which increases over the two years. Not only that, you’ll also continue to receive dedicated support from the team at Rockborne with regular 121s, mentoring and tailor made training plans that align to you and your assignment. At the end of an Assignment, there will be the potential to transition to the client company, taking a permanent role and next step in your career. If you're interested in exploring other options, we can support in identifying your next role through our sister company Harnham, one of the largest Data and AI recruitment agencies globally. You’ll also become part of our Alumni network, providing the latest data insights and trends, regular events and updates and access to a wide network of colleagues and peers across the data realm. We may not be able to provide everyone with an assignment through our clients but by completing our Academy and Advance programmes you will now have a wealth of training and experience to take to the job market. It’s completely free training, there is never anything to pay back and we will try our hardest to support you in finding your next role through either Rockborne or externally.
